$description: SYNAPSE Chromatic — primitive (reference) tokens. Raw OKLCH ramps with no meaning. Build-time only; not emitted as CSS variables. Semantic tokens alias these.

neutral.$description: Elevation + text ramp — the Obsidian cold void (v1.2.0, ADR-045). Hue 265 (deep blue-violet), chroma RISES with depth so the darkest surfaces read rich rather than dead grey, and the L steps between surfaces are LARGE enough that elevation is legible without borders (borderless depth). Keyed by approximate lightness x1000.

tier.$description: Decision-tier ramp (I-8). Ordinal data on the Lightness axis: one cognition hue (H258), strictly monotone-decreasing L from Tier 1 (reflexive) to Tier 4 (deep deliberation).

confidence.$description: Confidence diverging scale (I-5). Continuous in OKLab; hue rises monotonically red->amber->green->teal. Stops anchored at the gate thresholds 0.00 / 0.70 / 0.80 / 1.00.

state.$description: Semantic state hues. Hue intentionally overlaps the disruption/pricing/freshness agents (risk is red, value is gold, fresh is green); separation from agent colors is carried by lightness + chroma (INV-CLR-014). v1.1.0 (ADR-044) adds the two honesty states: degraded (caution-family hue, chroma drained to ~1/3 of warning — the colour is literally running on reduced information, the VSUP philosophy as a state token; the chroma gap survives CVD because CVD compresses hue, not chroma) and synthetic (violet, >60 deg from every other state; never colour-only — always paired with a dashed ring + glyph per INV-CLR-011).
